143606.overview: Else we get mad, a great beat ‘em up game for 1 or 2 players which offers nice and smooth graphics and typical retro tunes that keep you going for more. Enjoy this full game for any Amiga with 1 MB of RAM. The Christmas gift from AmigaWave team and Alex Brown for the Amiga Community.

143961.overview: This addon for Test Drive II features a race through Europe. Racing through the stages you cross following countries: The Netherlands, Germany, Switzerland, Italy, France and Spain.

144029.overview:
Europe 390 A.D. - the Migration Period: As the Western Roman Empire struggles to repel migrating Germanic tribes fleeing from the incursion of the Huns into Eastern Europe, several of its provinces are breaking away seeking independence.

In "Elysium", you rule one of these independent provinces. Your goal is threefold: (1) survive politically until the fall of the Western Roman Empire in 476 A.D.; (2) make your country the most livable for your people, turning it into an "Elysium", an island of the blessed in those turbulent times; (3) (optionally) build an empire of your own by conquering other provinces.

Your challenges are firstly foreign and secondly domestic: ward off pillaging barbarian tribes such as the Vandals or the Huns and defend against legions of Roman troops sent by the Emperor to forcibly reintegrate you into his failing Empire. This requires building, equipping and maintaining a whole army of militia, career soldiers and mercenaries, financed by a vibrant domestic economy. Thus your tasks at home include the production of agricultural and other goods and building the necessary infrastructure, trade by sea and land, law enforcement and taxation, and most importantly: stay in power by keeping the masses happy with "bread and circuses".

144030.overview:
After six years away from Earth, your delivery contract is finally over, you've been paid a fat cheque and you can't wait to get home. As your ship gets closer and closer to the old beloved blue planet, the anticipation mounts. But wait! What's this? The earth is an unfamiliar, grey husk! A vast alien mothership hangs above it, mercilessly sucking out all of its natural resources. While you were away, the Eco Phantoms arrived, and did this!

Now, you've managed to steal an Eco zeppelin craft and have gone down to Earth, to try to reverse the planet-draining process before it's too late. The Eco Phantoms have built several domes on the planet's surface, which house their buildings and equipment. You'll have to navigate through three of these domes, learning how to operate and maintain your alien craft, gathering resources, collecting data spheres, rescuing prisoners and engaging in confrontations with the Eco forces. Eventually, if you survive long enough, you'll be able to enter the alien mothership, where you will have to reprogram the main computer, to reverse the process and restore Earth to life.

Eco Phantoms is a hybrid game that contains exploration with an aircraft in pseudo-3D dungeon-like environments, action-based combat, arcade sequences, and puzzle-solving elements.

144031.overview: E.T.'s Rugby League is an Amiga rugby sports game released in 1992 by Ozisoft.

144033.overview:
Fantasy-themed strategic/managerial wargame. The premise is that in a vast continent made up of warring fiefdoms a king arose and unified the whole land. Eventually the once warring barons agreed that they couldn't live peacefully with each other and the king was assassinated while the sole heir was conveniently out fighting in the Crusades. You play one of this barons who must expand his starting territory and conquer the entire kingdom. Gameplay is phase-based and you have to do all sort of things from commanding armies and devicing combat strategies to managing your budding villages and fiefdoms by collecting taxes, recruiting, and balancing your checkbook.

The game includes a series of gameplay options to modify and create your own game modes. You can select the size of the kingdom, the amount of territory to be explored, the chances of random events, and there's even an option that makes the game a race against the clock as you try to get the kingdom before the rightful heir returns. Includes hot-seat multiplayer support for up to 4 players.

144034.overview: European Superleague is a managerial soccer simulation which is about an fictional European league featuring eight of the most successful teams (PSV Eindhoven, Glasgow Rangers, Liverpool, Arsenal, Real Madrid, Olympique de Marseilles, AC Milan and Bayern Munich). The player takes control over one of those clubs and is responsible for its athletic and financial success. The player has all the usual options available, including tactics, lineup, transfer market or training. A speciality is the weekly board meeting in which the chairman gives his opinion on the team's current stand. Each team has 20 athletes with abilities which influence their performance during the match (no graphical representation). The game is completely menu-based and the sub-menus are reached through the main menu which has a different graphical or text presentation depending on the used platform.

144044.overview: Eye is closely based on the board game with the same name. The game is played with two to four players on a board with differently coloured squares. Each player has playing stones of one colour and the goal to get a certain amount of the own stones on the corresponding fields. The spin on this concept is that the board is placed on two rotatable spirals which change the square distribution on the field when used. During each turn, a player has a different amount of moves available (changes depending on the current match situation); each move consisting of moving a square or turning a spiral. This computer version also allows some rule modifications in comparison to the original game and all opponents can be replaced by the AI.

146763.overview:
Licensed around former England player Peter Beardsley, this football (soccer) game is viewed side-on. The only playing option is the European Championship tournament of the day, although you can choose the 8 teams from the 26 major European footballing nations of the time (so the USSR, Czechoslovakia and Yugoslavia are all still complete). Two players can compete in these groups, but there's no guarantee of getting straight to a 2-player game, especially as tournaments (and individual matches) can't be quit out of.

The gameplay features variable strength kicks, determined by how long you hold the fire button for. In a break with realistic physics, the ball ricochets back in the direction it came from. Goalkeepers stay on the goal-line rather than using the whole penalty box.

148805.overview: A classic dungeon crawler made by Croatian developers Olympia Entertainment Group that was never officially released. According to some sites it was due to bugs however Evil's Doom became a victim of software piracy, after the beta version was sent to magazines, the first cracks appeared and the developers cancelled the game and left the Amiga.

177991.overview:
Explora 3 is a french point-and-click adventure game, the final sequel of the original Explora (released as Chrono Quest in English-speaking markets). The time traveling antics of the other games continue on this title, albeit in a more tangential way. You play as a writer with a severe lack of ideas that has a 3 month deadline to deliver a manuscript to his publisher. While watching TV you see your name linked to a report about a mysterious murder. It is your job to unravel this conspiracy.

The interface of the game has a more minimalist approach this time, the icons were reduced to only three revolving on the bottom-right of the screen: a magnifying glass to examine the scenario, a hand to pick and drop things, and a hammer as the "use" verb. Above these icons there is a clock: the developers added a dimension of time to the proceedings, and certain actions can only be performed at an exact time point. This installment also ditches the synthesized speech of the second game.

The games of this series share a common trait of being quite unforgiving: the player can easily get stuck on a unwinnable situation by forgetting to take some crucial object or not performing the exact action at the exact time. Death also comes swiftly and unexpected, sometimes only by opening a door at the wrong moment.

178129.overview: Enjoy the experience of orbiting a planet and then flying on the surface. Mankind has spread its roots to many solar systems both far and wide, and has colonized planets far beyond today's beliefs. This is not for the sake of exploration, but to mine for precious minerals and metals. The memory of man's first home has been lost to the sands of time and only myth remains. It is said that the planet that started life as they know it is Sola III, a politically important planet. However, the ozone layer has been fading well beyond your ability to regenerate it. The only chance for the planet is to find 6 rare nuclei to stabilize the ozone layer. You must take to the controls of the Enterprise and scan the galaxy for the needed items. You start in the cockpit of your ship with the controls at your fingertips.

181236.overview:
This computer coloring book is another part in the Electric Crayon series and it has 26 pictures of different Dinosaurs to color.

Pictures could be colored from a palette of 16 colors. A mix button would "mix" the current color with the 15 other colors and give a total of 256 colors. Choosing a color and clicking in the picture do a color fill in the area clicked. The finished, or in progress, coloring was automatically saved to disk. Player may also remove all colors applied previously to start coloring from the very beginning.

Pictures could be printed with, or without, a monthly calendar, description, message, banner, etc.

181246.overview: Euro league Manager includes 4 divisions of eighteen teams, 2 domestic cup competitions & European competitions. Promotion &  relegation  are    based upon four up & four down. Game starts in one of 3 difficulty modes. You must manage your team to the top of the heap and win big!

181247.overview:
Five card games are brought to life in this title – Baroness (AKA Five Piles), Frustration, Yukon, Stonewall and Black Maria. The basic game mechanics offer straightforward visuals, a range of card sets, saveable statistics, and click-to-drop or drag-and-drop control options.

Black Maria is a three-player game, which is similar to Hearts but with the opposite objective – i.e. you must hold the hearts and queens. The others are all solitaire, with Baroness and Frustration being largely luck based and involving matching cards up so they add to 13 in Baroness (aces low; kings go automatically) or 10 in Frustration (face cards pair with cards from the same rank).

Stonewall and Yukon both involve getting the cards to the foundations, which are built up in suit, and moving cards on the main play area (the ‘tableau’) by playing, for example, a red nine on a black 8. Yukon is a famed strategic game, notable for allowing multiple cards to be moved even if they aren’t in sequence, and presenting some cards face-down and some face-up, while Stonewall alternates the cards, with a face-up one on top of a face-down one.

181248.overview: The sequel to Excellent Card Games and it would be followed by Excellent Card Games III. Collection of 5 solitaire games: Quads; Rapide; Sir Tommy; Betrothal; and Cribbage.

181249.overview: The third game in the trilogy of Excellent Card Games titles.This one contains Poker, Czarina, Colours, Scottish and Napoleon solitaire games.

181537.overview:
This computer coloring book is another part in the Electric Crayon series and it has 30 pictures of different world places, such as Kremlin, Redwood, Taj Mahal, Fuji, Alps, etc., with Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles to color.

Pictures could be colored from a palette of 16 colors. Choosing a color and clicking in the picture do a color fill in the area clicked. The finished, or in progress, coloring was automatically saved to disk. Player may also remove all colors applied previously to start coloring from the very beginning.

Each picture has an educative description and could be printed.

181584.overview:
In the year 2068, humanity managed to conquer the fourth dimension: time. Time travel becomes so widespread that a danger arises - someone may try not only to learn about the past, but also to alter history. Now it is the year 2098. The player takes on the role of special agent Dino Szmit and his job is to pursue such time-villains. The adventure begins as the player wakes up after a time travel accident...

Eksperyment Delfin (Dolphin Experiment) is a point and click adventure that allows the player to travel in time to counter a Nazi conspiracy plot. The game takes the player back to the year 1942 and beyond. It's based on traditional inventory puzzles, enhanced by the ability to jump not only to another location to find a needed item, but also to a different time. The few conversations the player will have feature dialog options.

200790.overview:
In a typical business simulation, your job is to open a restaurant chain. But watch it: to succeed in Energie-Manager, you will have to pay close attention to ecological aspects. Try to win eco prizes, reduce costs with power saving washing machines and water saving toilets.

The game was published by German federal authorities in the early nineties to teach children about eco-conscious business behaviour and has been distributed for free since then.

207278.overview: Enigme a Oxford is an Adventure game, developed by Inference and published by Coktel Vision, which was released in Europe in 1989. Jonathan left the library of the university where he studied in Biology. He had managed to associate his studies and his passion for history in a thesis dealing with Captain Cook's diaries. He was no reaching the most fascinating point and was working on the micro-fiches reproducing the original documents. He regretted, however, that he would not be allowed to see any original drawings. Or could he?

207352.overview:
Originally released in 1991, improved and updated in 1992, vastly modified and finished for wide release in 2003. 
You must find the balance between the two sides. Each object has its own mass:
– The green ball weighs 1 Kg.
– The yellow ring weighs 2 Kg, it crushes the green ball.
– The blue triangle weighs 3 Kg and crushes yellow and green objects.
– The brown diamond weighs 4 Kg and crushes blue, yellow and green objects.
– The red pentagon weighs 5 Kg and it crushes all other objects when it falls.
– The gray square has no mass

The value of the next weight is displayed on the side of the central bar. The balance of the plateaus is visualized by a progress bar.

211498.overview:
In the western desert plains, a desolate landscape is cut by the railroad that will connect the two coasts of the North American continent. The railway is a steamroller that destroys everything in its path, farmers, ranchers, towns and Indian tribes … for this he has taken control of an army of armed men and also has the support of the government who sent troops. All this so that nothing can stop the railroad.

In a skirmish between some ranchers and the railroad gunmen, our protagonist is left for dead, his land is confiscated, and his entire world disappears. When he wakes up in the desert, he decides to come back as a masked man and get revenge on the railroad. But not only are the railroad and its henchmen the only dangers our lone vigilante faces, there are also dangerous animals on the plains and of course the plains Indians who are on the warpath and attack all those who enter. in their lands... Fight your way with your revolver and the aid of your horse to those at the head of the railroad company...

211548.overview: A point and click adventure created by DAS Software and released in 2001. It was originally begun in 1998 and had a few releases including bugfixes along the way. Entity follows on from Bud Lightening's adventures in The Experiment, and pits our hero against a new, more terrifying threat to Freedom and Justice than ever before encountered.

211557.overview:
It was like Christmas eve on the night of July 14th 1987 and the asylum was all amok with sounds of desperate psychotics, chewing their way through the leather straps on the straight jackets. Suddenly there was a large shrill, as the torn-up carcass of one of the doctors came hurtling through the swivel doors, almost landing on top of you. As you looked into the eyes of the corpse, a bedpan hit you in the back of the head, causing you to fall headlong into the remains of the somewhat mutilated doctor. 
 
You awoke some several hours later in the penitentiary state hospital, surrounded by armed troops. The nurse came over and gave you a shot of morphine. Later that night, the law came to talk to you. "Do you have any idea what happened?" asked one of hte officers. "Nope, I think I was hit on the back of the head with a steel potty." And then things started to get really weird....

211642.overview:
Escape from Hammy Town is a point & click graphic adventure. As the game begins, the main character has just emerged unharmed from the wreckage of a car, after veering off the road and crashing into a tree on the outskirts of an unfamiliar town. Our hero has almost no money, the car isn't going anywhere, and so the only option is to head into town and find some alternative way to get back on the road...

The game interface splits the screen vertically: the current scene is shown from a third-person perspective, while underneath is an action panel that displays the inventory items you are carrying, along with nine action buttons ("Give", "Pick up", "Use", "Open", "Close", "Talk to", "Look at", "Push" and "Pull") for manipulating objects and interacting with characters.

211741.overview: Released at Nordlicht 2018, this scrolling screen platformer features Elfie the happy unicorn. Elfie lived in harmony and peace. But a threat approached the land and the unicorns were threatened by Jack the Unicorn Hunter. How it is up to you to defeat Jack and protect the lands of the unicorn.

211742.overview:
Guide Ralph around a maze of wires,directing the sparks to turn off the circuits. You have to direct an electric current across each level, by getting to some precariously-placed switches, and alternating their position. There are lots of bad guys trying to stop you (for a not-readily-apparent reason; maybe they’re Green campaigners), and contact with them costs you a life.

The game’s most novel feature is one I’m pretty sure I’ve never seen before – it’s almost a gameplay interpretation of double buffering (the programming technique in which you have two copies of the screen, and draw graphics to the background one, swapping them once it’s all done, to speed up play and eliminate flicker). There are two sets of platforms, one behind the other, and a simple joystick motion switches you between the two.

211753.overview:
This game is the sequel to Emotional Conflict. In that game you tried to hunt down Mutant Mickey, a head-case, but upon finding him, you let him slip through your slimy, greasy, oily fingers. Though you did manage to recover the rare, lost coin. And now we're back, back FOR REVENGE, I tell you. This time, MM has kidnapped your Mother and is holding her hostage in this maximum security hotel, where rich celebrities like Mikey stay. You begin in the lobby and begin your revenge from there! 
 
Game came packed with a sub game called Wormzies. Asa Margetts was the creator and developer of this overhead, point and click PD game.

211758.overview:
Edd Schiester is a short point & click graphic adventure game for the Amiga, created with AMOS. The interface is a LucasArts-style control panel with verb action buttons like "Pick up" and "Talk to", but there is also one labelled "Violence!" used to attack characters in the game. The game has something of a sick sense of humor, and includes a warning screen that it is not intended for children. It was released as shareware in 1992 and distributed by software libraries such as 17-Bit Software.

The plot of the game is simple: the main character, Edd Schiester, has found himself trapped underground in a strange network of catacombs. The only goal is to find a way out.

Left-clicking the mouse is used to select verb actions and objects. If the right mouse button is clicked while the main character is walking, this cancels the walk movement, but does not prevent an action from happening afterwards: for instance, if you "Walk to" a door, and then immediately right-click, the new location loads immediately as if the main character had "warped" over to the door.

There are no conversation trees, but if you talk to a character twice they will usually something different the second time. The game's engine appears to only support exits at four fixed locations on the screen.

The only sound featured in the game is two music tracks that play during the title screens.

211760.overview: A German language adventure game from Culture and released to PC in 1991.

211765.overview: Easter Egg is an Amiga scrolling screen platform game developed and released by Amiga Fans using Backbone in 2016.

211774.overview:
"Engines" is a game in the Gravity Force-genre.  Other games in that
  genre is e.g.  Turbo Rakketti, Gravity Force II, Roketz and Bratwürst.
  You have a space-ship.  Gravity pulls the ship downwards.  By rotating
  the ship and using the engine you can navigate through the 2-dimensional
  landscape.  Add cannons and another player, and presto, you've got a
  shoot'em up-game.

211896.overview: Exxon is a Puzzle game, developed by Braindeath and published by Maxon, which was released in Europe in 1991.

212003.overview: Good quality puzzle game only has 16 where the prequel to this one had 50, the point of the game is simply to get from point A to point B to escape. The good thing with this version is that you can create the your own game with the included compiler and level editor.Escape II is an Amiga labyrinth/maze arcade game released in 1992 by The Assassins and could be had directly from the creator as well. The second disk contain all levels from Escape and lots of music modules for use with the compiler. The compiler program could be obtained by sending 5£ to the author as this was a shareware release.

212069.overview: And God appeared to King Lickerish in a vision saying, "Build up a tower to my glory that its tip touches heaven." And Lickerish replied but surely there is no-one who could build such an erection. And God did rebut him saying, "Now that's where you're wrong mate."

212132.overview: A turn-based fantasy strategy game from Kimmo Kasila released on the Amiga in 1998.

212305.overview: Created by James Weatherall, aka Wez and released to public domain in1997, this is a hack and slash adventure RPG game system, that includes experience, alignment, stats like strength, stamina, vitality, weapon skill, bravery and  panic conditions. Intended to be a more versatile version of Knights with more variety and difficulty and eventually the ability to create cities and use random dungeons.

212317.overview: Take control of one of the two robots and capture your opponent's key thereby completing the screen. To win you must either finish three screens more than your foe or kill him off. You start the game with 10 shields, the fireball weapon and 3 lives. Bonus weapons and lives are available by picking up the appropriate bonuses that appear on the screen. On screen are many hazards apart from your foe spikes, transporters, trapdoors, monsters, magnets and more!

212318.overview: A Breakout\Arkanoid clone by L. Donoghue that was released to PD in 1992.

212319.overview: A French language game created by Francois Lavialle of GFX Movies, make your way around the maze of danger and make your way towards the disk and then take the disk to the floppy drive to move to the next level.

212320.overview: Energy Mover is all about building an energy supply system. The player must find a proper way to change one type of energy to another (for example water energy to electrical energy), using specified number of available machinery and wires/pipes. The task must be done by a certain time limit. Some of the boards, which actually are world continents, contain an obstructions in the the shape of randomly occurring black holes or walls, destroying parts of the installation.

212321.overview: Eurofighter is a horizontal scrolling shoot 'em up for the Commodore Amiga. It was developed by S2N and released in 2017.

212322.overview:
A one or two player bombing game, featuring great graphics, cool levels and some thumping music (with additional download). Mr. Manix, the psychotic scientist has been experimenting on innocent people, turning them into monsters to be controlled by his computers. Naturally you (Billy) and your twin brother (Joel) are the only ones who have the nerve and the bombs to save the day!  
 
Almost every level contains a number of computer consoles that most be destroyed to get to the next area. If you destroy all the computers the remaining monsters will break down into wiggly blobs (your mother is a wiggly blob).

212323.overview:
You make your way along the all seeing lake. With each stroke, you progress nearer the Retna Muntains and ultimately into The Vision Wizards Domain. Your breath becomes short and your lungs heavy as you row upstream towards a fate as yet unknown, but soon discovered. Genetic optical bio organism will surround you.  
 
You are in a land known as IRIS...once a bright and happy place. Now a dark force is playing tricks with the landscape and also its inhabitants. The Vision Wizard has devised many obscure traps and mazes to hinder the everyday lives of the land's innocent folk. You, being either brave or stupid (Why not both!!), confronted the wizard and asked him to demolish the puzzling mazes. You got used to being and eye-borg but you still wanted your body back. Make your way through the 50 challenges to get your body back.

212389.overview: Avoid the moving mad faces, stay off the death heads and the spikes, pick up all the hearts and complete the level as quickly as possible or :( for sure.

212428.overview: An overhead racing game that went through many versions and was released under several names for both NTSC and PAL. .

212488.overview: Explore a subterranean maze in this Spanish language adventure game from Daniel (Laddh), released in 2015.

212747.overview:
An XOR clone. 15 levels of play which will melt your brain or whatever you are using in its stead. Only tested for Amiga 1200 and above. Magus and Questor are trapped in the 15 mazes of EOR. These include Dolly's Revenge, Patience Pending and The Decoder, and can be played in any order. Before going through the exit, they must collect every balloon from within the levels. All of this must be done in a limit of 2000 moves.

The characters have differing abilities, and can be swapped between at any time. Hazards to avoid include bombs, falling boulders and barriers. Four pieces of the map can be found and collected.

The physical rules of this top-down maze are somewhat bizarre, but consistent: dotted force-fields can be traversed (and neutralized) by horizontal passage, waved ones by vertical passage; fish will fall as surely and as lethally as the boulders in Boulderdash, while chickens will travel in the direction they are pointed until something gets in their way. Various explosive devices, dolls and even teleporters further contribute to the complication of moving around this maze. Should all its levels be successfully completed, information will be provided permitting the completion of the overarching meta-puzzle.

213696.overview: Considered a hidden gem of Amiga games, this was released on ASI-GAMES-VOL 144 and was created by Andrew Campbell. It has two variations of game: Gravity and Sliders. Brain Shave is the sequel to Enigma a PD game available on the Funhouse disk and on the Assassin's collection, in this new game. It is a game like White Rabbit or Enigma where the object of the game is to match up all the colored tiles by dragging them around the screen using a joystick controlled cursor. Select, press and hold fire and drag the file if it is free to move.

213819.overview: A cute and colourful Xmas 2D platformer, designed just for that special time of year.  Featuring 200 items to collect, a lovely Christmas tune and enemies to avoid, Elves' Dreamland was created by the map editor of Jet Set Billy, with all the graphics and music made by nittamituaki himself. But that's not all, as 7 out of 8 levels were actually based on commercial retro games such as Santa's Xmas Caper for Amiga/ DOS,  Plum Duff for the ZX Spectrum and many others!

213820.overview:
Emerald Mine II came with a level editor which enabled everyone to create their own standalone Emerald Mine games. But at the time of the release of Emerald Mine (I) there was already a level editor by Headcrash available. The Emerald Mine Clubs also created other editors, which were sometimes (or maybe always) improvements of existing level editors by Kingsoft. There were also editors available in which people could draw their own graphics and use these in their games. This is the reason why some of the downloadable games below contain different graphics from the original Emerald Mine. 
 
There are several games with the name alternately Emerald Mine IV or Emerald Mine 4 because of this. This version is by No One. The first 40 caves are remixed by The Blockheads, the last 40 caves are the original version.

213821.overview: The English Football Simulation also known as The German Football Simulation and known as Division 1: Football League Simulator is a Soccer\Football management game. Division One, now's your chance to manage a First Division soccer team and find out what it's like to achieve your ultimate ambition - to lead your team to the top. Every decision you make will be crucial. Do you buy or sell a player, increase the gate money or go for broke with a massive bet? If you are nice to your bank manager, he may finance you, but for how long. Everything you need is in this program. Have you got what it takes to lead your team to the ultimate, the top of Division One?

213822.overview: A Gauntlet inspired game created with the Shoot'em Up Construction Kit where you shoot swords at familiar wizards and ghosts as well as piles of bones. You must avoid the pits and not get touched by the baddies. There are power ups for your weapons, potions and gold to pick up to increase your score.

213823.overview: The ship is broken and so are you! Shoot the enemy in this vertically scrolling space shooter by Carsten Magerkurt, released in 1992. A public domain scrolling "shoot'em up" action-game, which contains eight different levels, bonus-stages and a high score table. It as released on Fish Disk #0804.

213824.overview: An indirect fire rethinking of the Space Invaders formula. In this your pistol-packing protagonist squares of against a small, but ever increasing amount of formation-flying bugs. Shooting the roof over the bugs causes chips to fall down that will kill the bugs, you can also hit them directly, but it is a tough shot as your bullet is much smaller than the roof chips that fall. The evil insectoids will also be dropping who knows what deadly shots at you, avoid those and stop the Evil Insects!

215044.overview: An Amiga port of the popular arcade game by Sunteam in the style of GameGear ESWAT. Just as in the original ...crime is getting out of control in Liberty City, and to combat the problem, the LCPD establishes a new unit, called ESWAT (Enhanced Special Weapons and Tactics). Police officers who are promoted to this unit wear a cyber-suit that contains state-of-the-art military equipment including two Turbo-Booster Thrusters, extra ammunition, and increased protection. In order to become an ESWAT member, all a dedicated police officer has to do is arrest enough criminal masterminds to progress through the ranks, which include Captain, Assistant Chief, and Chief.

215117.overview: A shareware game by Ian Quigley and Simon Leigh, released as Shareware in 1993. This single screen shape matching puzzle game has over 80 levles of play.

215333.overview: Enigma Device is a puzzle game, developed and published by King Publishing, which was released in 1988.

215511.overview: Scheduled for release circa 1995, the Amiga version of ENERGY was never released due to the ailing Amiga market following Commodore's bankruptcy in 1994. A horizontally scrolling futuristic, alien Shoot 'Em Up.

215518.overview: A Spanish language game by DimaSoft released in 1991, it is a conversational adventure of the Lord of the Rings. This game uses static images, which are beautiful and striking. The game appears to have had occasional updates until 1994.

218166.overview: An overhead maze action game created by Greippi for the Finity Games group in 2022 and released at the Posadas Party 2022 Autumn, ranked 1 in the Game Competition. In the game you are stuck in Limbo. The only way out is to clear most of the freaks on the way. Collect and use blasts to explode walls. 12 levels of AI generated wisdom await!

218416.overview: Inspired by David Crane's Ghostbusters, this is a short Amiga game developed for Tom Hall's Toybox Jam 4. As such, it only uses the "off the shelf" assets provided for the Jam.

218699.overview:
I woke up with a start, having fallen asleep doing some reading in bed. He still couldn't believe what he had heard: Charles, I'm dead!

It was just a few words that rang clear and terrifying as thunder. It was a deep and distant voice but of unmistakable origin. It was the voice of Baron Bradewick. Scared I looked at the clock. It was several minutes to 9. I got up quickly, I still had 3 hours to live...

Impressive, isn't it? This happens to me because I surround myself with bad companies. I wouldn't be in this mess if I hadn't been so fond of the occult, if I hadn't let myself be carried away by the damn Baron's strong personality and vast knowledge of the occult, if I hadn't simply thought to satisfy the wishes of a dying when I signed that damn pact, that voluntary surrender of my body. In three hours he will come for me, but I am willing to stop him.

218926.overview:
It's the year 2140, earth is almost completely destroyed after numerous wars and environmental catastrophes, and the people primarily live underground. The two enemy parties are the United Civilized States and the Eurasian Dynasty. In this RTS game, both are trying to conquer as much land as possible.

Earth 2140's game concepts overlap with those of the Command & Conquer lineage - mine resources, build units, and send them into battle with an enemy which must be tracked down. The two sides have different units, with the UCS advantaged by its Mercs and robotic infantry. There are cinematic cutscenes for each mission

218928.overview:
This dual-format expansion for the Amiga and Mac versions of Earth 2140 contains Mission Pack: Final Conflict, thereby offering 110 new missions (80 single player ones and 30 multiplayer maps), 6 new units, 2 new buildings and one new terrain.

Additionally, this expansion adds the LAN multiplayer mode that was missing from the original release of Earth: 2140 for the Amiga.

218930.overview:
The Zelds and the Moroi are at war, and only one can survive. Whichever side you take on, you have 20 different missions to win.

Basic gameplay involves building facilities to produce the units required to conquer your opposition. These include tanks, planes and various infantry units with different strengths and weaknesses - most are available to both sides. The more advanced units can only be produced by building factories and research facilities. All of this cost money, which is obtained through mining.

There is variety and the game's missions, as some involve attempting to survive in a tough position, others involve escorting a convoy, and there are levels conducted entirely at sea.

417670.overview: A parody title referencing Terminator: Judgement Day, this is in fact a 2D horizontally scrolling Shoot 'Em Up by Mario Klüser and released commercially in 1994.

418062.overview:
With the EUREKA collection, discover the wonderful worlds of knowledge! EUREKA software is a new generation of software based on the most advanced research in computer science and educational sciences. From a captivating scenario, they develop a pedagogy
active and lively based on reflection and personal work.

An interactive and user-friendly range:
- incorporating high-performance tools (calculator, word processing, logbook, electronic calendar, etc.) - aids adapted to each question asked, documentation sheets (Album of Worlds) - very easy to use: everyone has their work windows and its tools as it sees fit.
- A personalized follow-up:
permanently displayable success rate, personalized graphic assessments the software adapts to the level of the user, allows him to progress more quickly in the event of success or offers him
reinforcement tests in case of difficulties.
- Each software includes thousands of questions, very varied exercises, games. Numerous graphics, music and digitized sounds: with the EUREKA collection! aim for performance.
Visit the 5 regions of MATHEMATICA, accumulate points, discover the clues that will allow you to progress more quickly towards final success.
You will cover the essentials of the program in each
of these areas:

and volume/comprehension of utterances. 4/3: relative and rational numbers / powers / fractions / percentages / opposites and inverses, etc. / intervals / number sequences / square roots / solving complex problems.
Operations:
operations on relative and rational / complex expressions including powers and roots / rapid mental calculation / approximations, order of magnitude, various evaluations...
Equations, graphs and functions:
6/5: algebraic notations/equations with one unknown/fractional literal expressions various graphic representations/proportionality tables/statistical distributions/means/re, tre orthonormal.
4/3: equations with 2 unknowns / development, development and factorization of algebraic expressions / inequalities / io remarkable antities / various diagrams / statistics / frequencies linear / affine applications / vectors / introduction to probabilities.
Geometry:
6/5: polygons (parallelograms, triangles, etc.) circles, discs, arcs / secants and mudflats / symmetries / perimeters, areas, volumes / prisms and cylinders / angles / planes in space.
4°/3°: projections/distances in the plane and space / triangles / medians, bisectors, mediators, etc. / Pythagorean and Thales theorems/Chasles relation/spheres/pyramids / angles inscribed at the center / sine, cosine, tangent/
translations, vectors, rotations.

- Logic:
Puzzles and logic games/implementation of algorithms.

418097.overview:
With the EUREKA collection, you will discover the marvelous worlds of knowledge! EUREKA software is a new generation of software based on the most advanced research in computer science and educational sciences. From a captivating scenario, they develop a pedagogy active and lively based on reflection and personal work. An interactive and user-friendly range:

and volume/comprehension of utterances. 4/3: relative and rational numbers / powers / fractions / percentages / opposites and inverses, etc. / intervals / number sequences / square roots / solving complex problems.

418221.overview:
In this game you are Rif, a young fox, who is falsely accused of stealing the magical orb of storms. This orb is capable of predicting when storms will arrive. Obviously this is important to farmers, but it is just as important to the boar tribe, for their supply of mud.

You'll have to find the Orb and the real thief, to clear your name, save your girlfriend and prevent war with the boar tribe. While your doing this you'll encounter a much larger mystery: What is the origin of the tribes? Legend has it that the humans gave the animals the power of thought and speech, and then vanished. Who were they and what happened to them?

418355.overview: Elefanten! Is a German Language business simulation released 1993-06-11 on Amigo! issue 03/93. Conceived and produced by Elefanten Schuh GmbH (brand owner) in close collaboration with World Wildlife Fund (Germany). Promotional game for the Elefanten brand of shoes that I used to wear when I was a kid. A nature reserve somewhere in Africa hired you as its new director. Your task is to increase the population of elephants within 36 months. You manage the budget, buy property, and work on landscape care.

418377.overview: A vertically scrolling shoot 'em up game for one or two players including cooperative play.

418533.overview:
This computer coloring book is another part in the Electric Crayon series and it has 30 pictures of different Zoo inhabitants to color.

Pictures could be colored from a palette of 16 colors. A mix button would "mix" the current color with the 15 other colors and give a total of 256 colors. Choosing a color and clicking in the picture do a color fill in the area clicked. The finished, or in progress, coloring was automatically saved to disk. Player may also remove all colors applied previously to start coloring from the very beginning.

Each picture has an educational description.

Pictures could be printed with, or without, a monthly calendar, description, message, banner, etc.

418579.overview: A German language quiz game for people who think they can handle a day in the life of the Chancellor of Germany. Some of the questions feel very dated now, but it is a perfect time capsule of the 1991 time period.

420719.overview: Alpha demo of a vertically scrolling shooter from Javier Alcaniz. It features multiple waves of ships to destroy, land based objects to blow up with big explosions, and dark lifeless landscapes.

420859.overview:
A puzzle-platform shareware game by C. Dire, released in 1994. Collect the gems and avoid the robots. We find our hero, Yao, trapped in a dream in which he finds himself traveling through a crazy world, which includes futuristic settings inhabited by droids, to ancient settings occupied by mummies (who are surprisingly swift and flexible in their movements). 

At first, Yao is pleasantly surprised to find that there are enormous diamonds just waiting to be collected.  Unfortunately, Yao's dream is not as straight-forward as it first appears...  The inhabitants of this world are actually there to protect the diamonds and give out harsh punishments (namely death) to those caught trying to steal them. Rather than risking his welfare, Yao could forget about the diamonds (and his greed) - but in the strange way that dreams are, he realizes that collecting the diamonds is his only means of escape from this crazy world...

* PLAYING EVASIVE AKSION *
      Yao starts the game with;
         2 lives
         1 Drill
         1 Transporter  (called TSPTR in game)

You must guide Yao around each level collecting the diamonds. On the way you must be careful to avoid the baddies who guard them. As
well as using the ladders to travel between platforms you can also use DRILLS/TRANSPORTERS.  A level is completed when you have collected all the  diamonds.  However you gain a bonus if you collect them in a certain order.  This demo has 4 levels.

420917.overview: A platform game created as something of a coding exercise done mostly as a favor for Brian Bell who did most of the work on the Reality games Construction Kit circa 95 - 97. Gather the coins, candy and goodies. Head butt the smiling squares to get a goodie out of them. The color tower is a transporter to go to another one on the screen.

421002.overview:
ENFORCER demo is available on Vulcan's CD. Known as both Atmosfear and Enforcer, this is a very early version of a fake Doom clone written in AMOS. The selection of three weapons are standard; a pistol, shotgun and machine/plasma gun. Some sound and graphics, including the hand and pistol image, seem to have made a jump from Doom directly! A few monsters appear and attack from all directions.

It’s similar to Death Mask in that no real time 3D or texture mapping is involved. The first person view is created using the old Dungeon Master technique but some nifty animation makes the transition between blocks smooth. When walking forward the view bobs up and down and progresses convincingly. Similarly, turning around on the spot looks right, because the background is being scrolled horizontally to simulate the changing panorama. The bogus Doom style has its drawbacks in this case and produces a maze which is like the lines in graph paper. It’s excessively uniform and perhaps the limitations of the demo prevented further development. Vulcan would later publish Marble Eyes’ Genetic Species, so perhaps they realized the limitations of the fake style and went for the real thing instead.

421940.overview:
This is an unofficial port from a 1992 DOS game of the same name, ported to the Amiga by tukinem aka Pawel Tukatsch. This is a platform game with puzzle elements. You have to guide Jacek, the Electroman, around the levels, using such things as teleporters, while shooting enemies and collecting weapon power-ups. This latter activity is essential - over a period of time, your weapon downgrades itself, until you can't actually fire at all.

The game features in total 8 levels, on which there are three microchips that must be collected in order to proceed to the next. The difficulty level is very steep, and each death sets you back to your previously visited checkpoint, but fortunately already collected microchips stay collected. Checkpoints also serve as an additional difficulty factor, as once touched, they remove all your weapons, leaving you unarmed.

Unlike many platformers, you can't control your jumping mid-air, and the main protagonist can only jump and fall at a given angle. This proves an extra challenge as when there are enemies above or below you, perfect timing is essential in order to succeed.

Apart from the title screen, only the last level, which really is just a credit to the producers, has background music.

421986.overview: Take part as a chicken, avoid the objects, and kill the opposition! The game was created by Entactogenic Design and released in both demo and shareware versions in 1994. The demo version is limited to 3 levels, the full game has 50. Demo limits high score saving, ammo and music is not the upgraded version.

422022.overview: Get the electronic circuit working in this freeware offering by Roy Schneider and Sven Schroeder of Sculptor.

422024.overview: A freeware text adventure with optional graphics not compatible with the AGA chipset by David Lacey and Adam Balcomb. Written with the CAG adventure generator.

422030.overview: A BoulderDash style game created with the Emerald Mine Editor released a part of the Emerald Mine Club Holland disk sets.

422031.overview: A Boulder Dash style game created with the Amiga Emerald Mine Editor and released commercially in November of 1991.

422044.overview: Find your way out of the 3D first-person maze in this freeware game created by Vaxine in 1990.

422056.overview: Created by (King) Knut Olav Loite using AMOS and the Amiga E program. It was released as shareware and as part of the CU Amiga Magazine Super CD-ROM 8.  Learn as you travel around Europe. Gather info on the places and the people you can see.

422218.overview: Experts Only is a 1987 freeware crosshairs shooter game by Daniel Cardenas. It was released as PD on Fish Disk 78 and feels the answer to the question of what arcade Battlezone would have been like as a crosshairs military shooter.  A neat (and tough!) PD game that was originally developed for eventual commercial release but for various reasons the author decided to release as PD instead.

422323.overview: An AMOS based freeware game by Spyros Paraschis, made in 1993 and based on the classic space invaders but with some really new configurations of aliens.

422360.overview: A Boulderdash game compiled by No One Inc and sold as shareware from Ruppelware and published by the Emerald Mine Club Holland in 1995.

422570.overview: An educational mathematics quiz\testing game for more complex mathematics including multiplying rational numbers, division of rationa numbers, adding and subtracting of rational numbers , published by Mikrozet and released in 1994.

422606.overview: A Polish-language, educational game focused on adding integers, subtracting, whole numbers, multiplying whole numbers. First released by Mikrozet in 1991, there were re-released at least twice more.

422709.overview:
You live in Paris, your surname is Renard and you are 26 years old. You've recently received a message from New York, together with a plane ticket and a check. "Please come urgently, I must see you. A letter is waiting for you in New York. " Who is he, what does he want from you? There is no name, no explanation, only the initials J.P.S.  
 
Choose the locations you will visit and explore the mystery while you explore the city of New York.

422828.overview: An AMOS based RPG created by Manuel Antonio Rodriguez and released as freeware in 1995.

422833.overview: Edball from Matthew Winchester is a standard Amiga SEUCK game that loops levels, unfortunately there seems to be no way to earn extra lives.

422846.overview:
After the not-so-successful text adventures The Name Rose (1990) and  Cesta Bojovníka (1991) , Kamil Blažek published another one, this time from the environment of a gypsy housing estate. As the hero Koudelka, we go there to rescue "the unsurpassed programmer Kamil, who was kidnapped by gypsies because he didn't want to give them his Amiga". The title of course refers to the Czech film Ecce homo Homolka (1969).  
 
As in the previous cases, this is essentially  a choose your own adventure , where we are always presented with a situation and offered several options on how to proceed. We then choose from them using the letters A, B, C, while usually only one option is correct and the others mean death and the necessity to start from the beginning. The game is still extremely short , but at least there is a small shift when branching off in one place (we may or may not go to the pond after the children), so the passage is not strictly linear.

The game was released as part of Amiga Wave in 1992.

422881.overview: A Spanish language, homebrew AMOS casino game. Escoba is a Spanish variant of the Italian fishing card game Scopa, which means "broom", a name that refers to the situation in the game where all of the cards from the board are "swept" in one turn. The game is usually played with a deck of traditional Spanish playing cards, called naipes.

423003.overview: A shareware featuring the gods and legends of Greek mythology created in Blitz Basic by William Jordan in 1993.

423012.overview: Star Wars: Escape From Mos Eisley is a homebrew 2015 simple text adventure game created using AMOS.

423031.overview: An unfinished shooter created by Christian Weber and Roman Werner using ASM 68k in 1987 as an alpha tester\demo version.

423034.overview: A shareware strategy game by Roland Richter set in Europe. The aim of this beautiful game is to acquire a country - but the way there is not revealed! Successful trading simulation.

423036.overview: A Spanish language text adventure. El Cetro del Sol is an adventure game, in text mode, developed by Toni Pera. In fact, he himself defines it as a festival of puzzles. The main character, Alejandro Núñez, discovers a map and goes to the Central American jungle in search of the secrets of a disappeared civilization.

423169.overview:
A shareware role playing game from John Scott. Mt. Doom, long dormant is about to erupt! IN a futile attempt to prevent this, the cave dwelling Trogs have kidnapped Princess Elena and intend to sacrifice her to the mountain gods. Your mission is clear - inexperienced as you are, you must enter the caves, set her free and Escape From MOUNT DOOM!! 
 
There were two versions of this game, a PD demo version with limited scope and the full shareware version.

423361.overview: History strategy shareware game that is fast, complex and easy to play. Mouse controlled with a zoomable map of the Roman empire. Had two additional data disks of scenarios to explore, also shareware.

423420.overview: A freeware puzzle game by Martin Kees in 1990 where you must decipher the workings of the Enigma machine and figure out how to work this crazy thing!

423508.overview: Egon the game is a freeware adventure game with German text created in AMOS by Scum Amiga Software in 2002. Move the character with joystick or cursor keys. Go to an object and press fire/space. Select an action with mouse.

423589.overview:
El Capitán Trueno (Captain Thunder) is the name of a famous Spanish comic book which tells the ongoing story of the eponymous 12th-century hero. This is the first game dealing with the character, released to all of the Spanish-speaking world's most vital computing platforms at the time with all ports except for the PC version contain two different segments, the first a calmer adventure portion followed by some frenetic arcade action.

The final mission is to rescue Sigrid, Trueno's beloved, from the monastery of his friend Abbot Estanislao de Castiglione. Along the way, the Capitán will have to face giant spiders, skeleton soldiers, enormous rats and a plethora of imaginative creatures such as the Abbot transformed into a demonic goat. The Capitán strives to triumph over all these opponents with the assistance of his friends sturdy Goliath, who though immobile can lash out with meaty fists and jump in place to cause earthquakes, and nimble Crispín, a man who can shimmy up a rope of any length. 
 
Shop of the game. In it you can buy from several options such as, to fill with energy for 5000 coins, buy a life for 8000 coins or increase the power of the sword by 4000 coins, up to a maximum of 2 times. Follow the on-screen instructions to know how to purchase each upgrade. To get back to the game click back.

423633.overview: Finding the story offers the child several sequences of events. Each sequence involves three images, which he must manipulate in order to put them in the proper chronological order. Several levels and game play modes are offered in relation to the child's age and progress. This game was released in Europe, published by Carraz Editions in 1989.

423810.overview:
ETEACHER from Bilang Software & Nahlik Soft, as the name suggests, is intended to act as an English teacher. The program has a very user-friendly installer, correct interface, efficient Help system, ability to choose from several different (very good) music. It features dictionary connections, sentence completion, transformation of sentences with beginnings, transformation of sentences with words, formulating questions and translating sentences.  

There are three options for working with Eteacher: learning (we can make mistakes with impunity), test (our achievements will be assessed by the program) and editing (we can create our own intelligent device mounted by default in the Devs directory). The remaining types of tasks accept up to six correct answers. In the manual, we read that the program has very strict requirements regarding answers. We have a choice in the following sets of exercises: choice tests, strict vocabulary exercises, extended exercises, Detailed nightlife fantasies, a twice updated and extended dictionary. You can even create your own collections within the above-mentioned task types. Additionally, you can add your own descriptions and so-called Hints, i.e. tips in both Polish and English. When we think that we can solve some tasks and we would like something a little more difficult rather than simpler, Eteacher contains tasks with three levels of difficulty.

423881.overview: The Emerald Mines CD contains the Boulder Dash-clone Emerald Mine and a collection of 177 level sets for it, each of them containing 80 levels. The player can also choose to customize their playing experience by selecting different graphics or sound effects sets before starting the game. Most of the levels were created by Emerald Mine fan club members.

424415.overview:
Emerald Caves, A New Emerald Mine Clone with 64 Brand New Levels for your Amiga! Emerald Mine is a 1987 puzzle video game developed and published for Amiga and Atari ST by Kingsoft. The series follows mines filled with various gems, such as emeralds. It is a Boulder Dash clone in which the player completes levels by collecting a specific amount of gems before reaching the exit. Emerald Mine was Kingsoft’s best-selling title with reviews generally favourable, and spawned several sequels.

Emerald Caves is an Emerald Mine clone, a nod to the past and features 64 brand new levels to test your skills. Challenging but fun! Emerald Caves is available for OCS and AGA Amiga.

424713.overview: Program for learning English, divided into 26 topics. The dictionary editor has been attached. There are two modes available in the program: study and timed test. In the test mode, the player receives points, while in the learning mode, he repeats the wrong answer until he gets the correct answer. After completing the test, a grade is issued.

424781.overview: Even if the title screen shows 'English Tester 2' it was sold in a box just labelled 'English Tester'. The 2 in the title means version 2. ENGLISH TESTER is a program supporting the learning of words, phrases and idioms. Very attractive graphic form, ability to add your own lessons, interesting visual and sound effects. 440415.overview:
A football manager game which was due out for the Commodore Amiga 1200 in 2000/2001. The game was being created by the Barczyński brothers, and was written in AMOS. Euro Round-Up: Czech Republic was the first of several management games planned by Frey United Software, which would simulate European football – all games would utilize the same interface and style. This particular development would focus on Czech Republic and its teams.

The creators were heavily inspired by the original Championship Manager, with each release concentrating on a single country, and trying to simulate the internal structures of their football leagues.

Apart from Czech leagues in this particular title, there would be a snapshot of other domestic leagues from around Europe – where you could take part in international competitions, have options to improve the stadium, send scouts abroad and buy players directly from those clubs.

443046.overview: A shape memory game created in 1988 using Blitz Basic and published by Courbois Software in The Netherlands. The well-known search game now on the computer. Find the correct text for the pictures. With many different drawings.

443931.overview: The third game in the German-language trilogy, this one also made using The Director by Harry Herweg and Holger Manz of CD-Soft, but this one is a rehash of a game originally put out in 1988 by Commodore, but by the same authors. Still a multiple selection quiz, edutainment game. This entry is back to being focused on Germany and surrounding areas.

444005.overview:
Centuries ago, humanity escaped the Solar System and colonized the stars. We encountered a similarly expansionist race and total war ensued. Victory came at the cost of billions of lives and many worlds were destroyed or found themselves cut off from the rest of the galaxy.

Our colony survived but lost the means to travel or communicate beyond our star system.

Now, more than eighty years after it was thought destroyed in battle, an enormous star ship is drifting through our system, within reach:

 Despite being badly damaged and infested with alien monsters, if it can be recovered, the technology contained on board will mean a fresh start and bright future for our world.

Your team of three robots has been sent to the Ecliptic. Guide them as they make repairs, clear out aliens and overcome the onboard security systems. They must reach the bridge, take control of the ship and bring it home. 

Ecliptic is a mixture of turn based tactical combat and role playing for the Commodore Amiga. Some of its influences are Space Crusade, UFO: Enemy Unknown and the Gold Box Dungeons & Dragons games.

Visually, it is intended to evoke the retro-futuristic science fiction of the 1970s and 1980s – think Aliens.

449657.overview:
Erdkunde 1 (Geography I) is an educational program of the M&T software series "Learning by playing!" The topics are wide-ranged. It covers the entire Federal Republic of Germany including the new federal states. The learning part provides information about the historical development of cities, the geographic location of rivers, industrial development, sights and much more. It was created by Harry Herweg, Holger Manz of CD-Soft using The Director and published by Markt & Technik in 1991. 

The quiz contains 300 different questions about the items described in the tutorial. In addition, some questions about general knowledge about Germany are built in. The questions are asked in such a way that a learning effect is also achieved when guessing. Using the boxes A, B, C, and D, the possible correct answer is selected with the left mouse button. If the answer is incorrect, the correct answer is displayed and the option is left to compare the question with the correct answer.

449658.overview:
Erdkunde II is the sequel to the original game, and the next level of Geography training and edutainment, covering, not Germany, this time, but the USA. Erdkunde II (Geography 2) is an educational program of the M&T software series "Learning by playing!" The topics are wide-ranged. The quiz contains 300 different questions about the items described in the tutorial. In addition, some questions about general knowledge about the U.S. are built in. The questions are asked in such a way that a learning effect is also achieved when guessing. Using the boxes A, B, C, and D, the possible correct answer is selected with the left mouse button. If the answer is incorrect, the correct answer is displayed and the option is left to compare the question with the correct answer. 
 
Let's combine the inspiring with the useful and create the series while learning through play! It shouldn't only work to reassure worried parents, but also to impart knowledge to all Amiga friends. Stupid cramming is replaced by  entertainment, by adventure and quizzes; Despite this seemingly paradisaical state, the learning effect is retained. The topics are wide-ranging. The learning programs in the Learn to Play series pave a new educational path not only for students, but also for adults. 
 
Geography II covers history and geography. Included: A 31/2" program disk of the USA with all federal states. You will develop your knowledge in the learning part; If that's too dry for you, you can convert your acquired knowledge into points in the quiz section.

451886.overview:
The third in a series of maze puzzle games games from Mark Page, Daniel Leyden and the Mad Phantom, collectively known as first Kryptic then as Cybernetix. While the first two entries of the game were freeware, this one was released as Shareware in 1992.

The problem is that you have to take the kind of circuitous route that involves visiting every other point from C to Z and well into Greek alphabet territory as well. Escape 2 is a futuristic puzzler featuring matter transporters, vanishing tiles, switches which operate sliding doors (usually on the other side of the screen) and tight time limits.

451910.overview:
Originally released in 1983 and republished by jotd666 aka Jean-François Fabre (Jeff Fabre) and Andrzej Dobrowolski (no9) in 2024. For the ECS version you'll need 2MB of total memory. For the OCS version you'll need 1MB of total memory. The OCS version doesn't include music and has reduced SFX. This is a remake of Elevator Action for OCS, AGA and ECS Amigas.  
 
Like the original, you are Agent 17 (codename: "Otto"). Your mission is to secure all top secret documents from a security building and escape in the getaway car, located in the basement of the building.

Enemy spies are scattered throughout the 30-floor building and they have only one mission: execute Agent 17 at all costs. There are several ways in which Agent 17 can kill them:

    Shooting them with his gun.
    Kicking them by jumping onto them.
    Shooting a light on the ceiling while in an elevator, dropping the light onto one of them.
    Crushing them with an elevator.

Whenever a light has been dropped, the hallways will be dark for a short period of time, making the enemy spies harder to see. The same holds true for hallways that are already dark.

While Otto is in an elevator, he will have complete control of it by moving up or down. Agent 17 can still get killed if he's already in an elevator if a bullet's trajectory is aimed at it. When Otto is not in an elevator, it will move from floor to floor automatically, even when enemy spies are in it. Otto is able to leap over the elevator gaps, but he must be as close to the edge as possible without falling off in order to make the jump safely. If there is an elevator cable in the way, however, it will block him, causing him to fall.

Just because the game is called Elevator Action doesn't mean that elevators are the only means of travel. There are also escalators which you can ride up or down, useful if you want to avoid gunfire and don't have time to jump.

Otto must go into the rooms with red doors to collect the top secret documents. If he tries to get to his car without getting all the documents, he cannot escape and must go back and collect the remaining documents. Once he has all the documents and drives away, he then proceeds to the next building.

If Otto takes too much time to collect the documents, the alarm will go off, and he will have trouble controlling the elevators, which will take time to react. Bad guys will be especially aggressive. The alarm doesn't go off when Otto loses a life, it only resets after finishing a building. Besides ducking, bad guys may also drop themselves and lay flat on the floor. It's virtually impossible for Otto to shoot bad guys when they do this. Also, Otto cannot duck when in an elevator.

451925.overview:
European Player Manager, a new and improved version of 5th Dimension Licenceware's British Manager. While it could scarcely be described as being at the cutting edge of computer football game development, being more on a par with the original 8-bit Football Manager than the likes of Championship Manager , it's nevertheless quite good tun.  You pick one of forty European teams, choose your kit and then it's on into die football season.

You pick your first team from the squad of eighteen players who are at your disposal and send them into battle in three competitions - the league, a European knockout cup and the UEFA cup. The two cup competitions have curiously reverted to one-legged affairs, and the European Superleague actually consists of four divisions of ten teams hut, as you’ll realize very quickly, realism isn't what European Player Manager is all about. If you can put up with watching United lose 5-0 at home to Napoli in front of 23,300 fans when £400,000-rated Peter Schmeichel has an off-day, then this is for you!

454602.overview:
The AGA version of the 1994 quirky classic. Although Empire Soccer 94 was released on the A500 there was a special unreleased AGA version which featured better graphics, team editors an indoor pitch and other improvements. Rather than copying Sensible Soccer or Kick Off, this football game features a number of comical and unrealistic touches. Although the view is top-down, the pitch is small and square, and the players appear huge on it. A range of moves including overhead kicks, trapping the ball, and quick 1-2 passes can be mastered.

Before each match, your team can choose special moves to assign to each player - power shots with a crazy-big curve, super dribbling (making the ball stick to your foot), and a Barge power to push players out of the way. A full world cup tournament is offered, which up to 8 human players can partake in, as well as single exhibition matches. The action replays feature a VCR-style control.
